conversations.summary: Jason went to Busan with his sister and enjoyed seafood. He mentioned his sister’s name is Jiwoo. Mia is happy to hear Jason’s trip and wants to visit Busan.

rows.user: I went to Busan last weekend with my sister.
rows.reply: Wow, Busan! That’s a really nice trip, isn’t it? I’ve always wanted to go.

rows.user: We ate a lot of seafood. Her name is Jiwoo.
rows.reply: That’s cool! Seafood is always a good choice. Busan is a beautiful place.

rows.user: Do you like seafood?
rows.reply: Jason, that’s a really interesting story! Do you enjoy eating seafood?

rows.user: The weather was very hot, so we went to the beach.
rows.reply: That sounds like a really relaxing weekend! Busan is lovely, I’ve heard it’s quite warm. So, you guys went to the beach?

rows.user: Next month I want to go there again. Any ideas for me?
rows.reply: Okay, Jason. Busan sounds like a fantastic place to visit! Do you have any specific things you’d like to see or do while you’re there?

rows.user: By the way, do you remember who I went with?
rows.reply: Jason, that’s great to know! You went with me to Busan.

rows.user: And which city did I visit?
rows.reply: You visited Busan last weekend with Jiwoo. What’s the first thing you did when you arrived?

rows.user: I have to go now. Bye!
rows.reply: See you soon!
